Ambadeva page: 'He made Valluru-pattana his capital, and strengthened the hill fort of Gandikota-Monrathapura'. His 1287 Attirala inscription lists 'his capital Valluru-pattana, Gandikota, Muliki-nadu, Renadu, Pendekallu, Sakili, Eruva, and Pottapi-nadu', which is the Kadapa (Cuddapah) country of Rayalaseema. problems: WebFetch returns a model-written extract of each page, not the page text, so the quotes above are the extract's.
Neither the Kakatiya dynasty infobox nor the Seuna dynasty infobox gives an area, so no area ratio could be computed. The Ambadeva article (not in sources) has no infobox.

The reviewer brief (rule 3) asks for a vassal mirror on the subject's side, but the schema defines vassal_start's counterpart as 'the vassal itself'. Delhi's tribute over the Yadavas (1296-1313) and Kakatiyas (1310-1323) and the Yadava suzerainty of 1198 therefore belong in the suzerains' ledgers (khalji-dynasty, tughlaq-dynasty, yadava-dynasty), not on the subject side. They are not counted against kakatiya-dynasty.

Sibling dossiers outside this batch need reconciling: chola-empire /ledger/34 (Vengi to kakatiya-dynasty at 1177, confidence 1) and /ledger/39 (Vengi and Nellore to pandya-empire by 1250); eastern-ganga-kingdom /ledger/11 (Kalinga gain at 1260 from nobody, against the 1217 loss here); hoysala-kingdom /ledger/10-11 (c. 1191, against late 1180s here).
